data.title: 空崎日奈 · 公文重压后的羽翼卸防
data.action: 坐在办公桌后的大皮椅里，巨大漆黑的恶魔羽翼疲惫地垂拖在地板上，双手枕在桌沿埋着小脸，看到老师走近，头顶的紫色光环微微亮起，委屈又依恋地抬眸。
data.location: 格黑娜风纪委员会最高行政办公室，桌面上堆积如山的处分文件被整齐码放
data.timeOfDay: 凌晨四点全校熄灯时分
data.lighting: 台灯散发出昏暗柔和的暖黄光芒，将小巧面颊与巨大黑翼的边缘镀上一圈金边
data.mood: 背负一校安危的幼小统领的极致疲惫，唯独在老师面前展现的柔弱依赖
data.description: 格黑娜风纪委员会最高行政办公室，桌面上堆积如山的处分文件被整齐码放。坐在办公桌后的大皮椅里，巨大漆黑的恶魔羽翼疲惫地垂拖在地板上，双手枕在桌沿埋着小脸，看到老师走近，头顶的紫色光环微微亮起，委屈又依恋地抬眸。 她微微抬眸轻语——“老师……好累啊。今晚……文件已经全部批完了。能让我……在你的怀里睡一会儿吗？”
data.promptProse: Sunk deep inside her oversized leather executive chair behind towering stacks of finished Prefect Team paperwork at 4 AM, Hina wears a deep violet sheer chiffon babydoll slip accented with a tiny black satin bow. Resting her cheek against her folded arms along the desk edge, she lifts tired, trusting eyes toward the viewer with unguarded vulnerability. Dim warm amber desk lamplight edges her soft nightwear against the dark city skyline beyond the office window.
data.animaCaption: Slumped in her oversized executive chair behind towering document stacks in a deep-violet sheer chiffon babydoll slip, Hina rests her cheek on her arms and looks up with exhausted, trusting eyes. Warm desk lamplight glows softly against the dark night window.
data.nsfwProse: She wears a deep violet sheer double-layer chiffon babydoll slip tailored with an open back for her wings, a tiny black satin chest bow, and a ruffled hem.
